placement.placementAuditNote: NIRF 2025 UG 4-year batch graduating 2023-24: 2,412 graduated, 653 to higher studies, 1,759 placed of 1,759 eligible. Median Rs 1,325,000. CTC vs base and domestic/international not stated. Other official DTU docs print 85.3 LPA (tnp.dtu.ac.in 2023-24 highlights PDF, B.Tech COE/MCE/ECE max CTC 85.3; CSE dept page: 85.3 LPA Atlassian, window 1 Aug 2023-31 Jul 2024); 85.03 vs 85.3 discrepancy is in DTU's own documents.
